entities.name: EMM Information procedure
entities.description: Procedure invoked by the network to provide information to the UE. Implementation is optional in the network.

entities.name: EMM INFORMATION message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to provide information to the UE. The UE may use the received information if supported.

entities.name: Established EMM context
entities.description: Condition where an EMM context has been established between UE and network.

relations.description: The EMM Information procedure involves sending the EMM INFORMATION message.
The EMM Information procedure may be invoked when an EMM context is established.
